description: Abstract base for a metric owner's operation request contract (ADR-0007). One concrete contract is published per metric and validates the operation-level metadata object shared by every subject scope and caller.

metric.description: The single registered metric governed by this request contract.

constraint_contract.description: The concrete arbitration-constraint contract attached to this metric request contract.

type.description: The concrete owner-published metric request contract selected by QE; consumers do not supply this type.

metadata.description: The operation-level metadata object refined by the concrete contract and supplied once per evaluation request.
